   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

z_measurement[2] := x_hat[2] + (rPodVerticalAcceleration_ms2 * tSampleTime_s);
z_measurement[3] := rVehiclePitchAngle_mrad * 0.001;   (* Pitch in rad *)
z_measurement[4] := rPodPitchRate_rads;

(* 3.1 Time Update: x_pred = A_d * x_hat + B_d * u_control *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    tempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        tempSum := tempSum + (A_d[idx, jdx] * x_hat[jdx]) + (B_d[idx, jdx] * u_control[jdx]);
    END_FOR;
    x_predict[idx] := tempSum;
END_FOR;

(* 3.2 Covariance Predict: P_predict = A_d * P_cov * A_d^T + Q_proc *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR jdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        tempSum := 0.0;
        FOR kdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            tempSum := tempSum + (A_d[idx, kdx] * P_cov[kdx, jdx]);
        END_FOR;
        P_cov[idx, jdx] := tempSum + Q_proc[idx, jdx];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* 3.3 Innovation & Kalman Gain: K = P * C^T / (C * P * C^T + R) *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    tempDelta := P_cov[idx, idx] + R_meas[idx, idx];
    IF tempDelta > 0.00000001 THEN
        K_gain[idx, idx] := P_cov[idx, idx] / tempDelta;
    ELSE
        K_gain[idx, idx] := 0.5;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* 3.4 Measurement Update: x_hat = x_pred + K * (z - x_pred) *)
FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    y_residual[idx] := z_measurement[idx] - x_predict[idx];
    x_hat[idx]      := x_predict[idx] + (K_gain[idx, idx] * y_residual[idx]);
    P_cov[idx, idx] := (1.0 - K_gain[idx, idx]) * P_cov[idx, idx];
END_FOR;

    rCorrectedShaftSpeed_Ncorr := rCompressorShaftSpeed_rpm;
END_IF;

IF rCompressorInletStagnationPressure_mbar > 0.05 THEN
    rCorrectedMassFlow_Wcorr := (rCompressorInletMassFlow_kgs * SQRT(rCompressorInletTemperature_K / 288.15)) /
                                (rCompressorInletStagnationPressure_mbar / 1013.25);
ELSE
    rCorrectedMassFlow_Wcorr := rCompressorInletMassFlow_kgs;
END_IF;

(* Surge Limit Line: Pi_surge = c0 + c1*W + c2*W^2 + c3*W^3 *)
rSurgePressureRatio_Limit := 1.25 + (0.428 * rCorrectedMassFlow_Wcorr) - 
                             (0.0182 * rCorrectedMassFlow_Wcorr * rCorrectedMassFlow_Wcorr) +
                             (0.00031 * rCorrectedMassFlow_Wcorr * rCorrectedMassFlow_Wcorr * rCorrectedMassFlow_Wcorr);

IF rSurgePressureRatio_Limit > 1.05 THEN
    rSurgeMargin_pct := ((rSurgePressureRatio_Limit - rTotalPressureRatio_Pi) / (rSurgePressureRatio_Limit - 1.0)) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rSurgeMargin_pct := 30.0;
END_IF;

rKantrowitzChokeRatio := (rCompressorInletMassFlow_kgs * SQRT(rCompressorInletTemperature_K)) /
                         (rCompressorInletStagnationPressure_mbar * 0.48 * 0.0404);

rMassFlowDerivative := (rCompressorInletMassFlow_kgs - rMassFlowPrev) / tSampleTime_s;
rMassFlowPrev       := rCompressorInletMassFlow_kgs;

(* Anti-Surge Controller *)
rAntiSurgeError := (15.0 - rSurgeMargin_pct);

IF rAntiSurgeError > 0.0 THEN
    rAntiSurgeIntegral := rAntiSurgeIntegral + (rAntiSurgeKi * rAntiSurgeError * tSampleTime_s);
    IF rAntiSurgeIntegral > 100.0 THEN rAntiSurgeIntegral := 100.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rAntiSurgeIntegral := rAntiSurgeIntegral * 0.98;
    IF rAntiSurgeIntegral < 0.0 THEN rAntiSurgeIntegral := 0.0; END_IF;
END_IF;

rAntiSurgeDerivative := (rAntiSurgeError - rAntiSurgeErrorPrev) / tSampleTime_s;
rAntiSurgeErrorPrev   := rAntiSurgeError;

IF rAntiSurgeError > 0.0 THEN
    rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := (rAntiSurgeKp * rAntiSurgeError) + rAntiSurgeIntegral + (rAntiSurgeKd * rAntiSurgeDerivative);
ELSE
    rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF (rMassFlowDerivative < rAntiSurgeFastOpenTriggerRate) OR (rSurgeMargin_pct < 5.0) THEN
    rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 100.0;
    rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := 50.0;
    wFaultWord1.8                    := TRUE;
ELSIF rSurgeMargin_pct < 10.0 THEN
    rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := (10.0 - rSurgeMargin_pct) * 10.0;
ELSE
    rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct > 100.0 THEN
    rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct < 0.0 THEN
    rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rKantrowitzChokeRatio > 0.85 THEN
    rCompressorGuideVaneAngle_deg := -10.0 + ((rKantrowitzChokeRatio - 0.85) * 65.0);
ELSE
    rCompressorGuideVaneAngle_deg := ((rCorrectedShaftSpeed_Ncorr / 25000.0) * 30.0) - 10.0;
END_IF;

IF rCompressorGuideVaneAngle_deg > 45.0 THEN
    rCompressorGuideVaneAngle_deg := 45.0;
ELSIF rCompressorGuideVaneAngle_deg < -15.0 THEN
    rCompressorGuideVaneAngle_deg := -15.0;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) LEVITATION QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
x_setpoint[1] := rSupervisoryLevitationSetpoint_mm * 0.001;
x_setpoint[2] := 0.0;
x_setpoint[3] := 0.0;
x_setpoint[4] := 0.0;

FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
    u_prev[idx] := u_control[idx];
END_FOR;

FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO 12 DO
    FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
        tempSum := 0.0;
        FOR jdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            tempDelta := (A_d[jdx, 1] * x_hat[1]) + (A_d[jdx, 2] * x_hat[2]) + 
                         (A_d[jdx, 3] * x_hat[3]) + (A_d[jdx, 4] * x_hat[4]) +
                         (B_d[jdx, 1] * u_control[1]) + (B_d[jdx, 2] * u_control[2]) +
                         (B_d[jdx, 3] * u_control[3]) + (B_d[jdx, 4] * u_control[4]) - x_setpoint[jdx];
            tempSum := tempSum + (B_d[jdx, idx] * Q_weight[jdx] * tempDelta);
        END_FOR;
        gradient_J[idx] := (2.0 * tempSum) + (2.0 * R_weight[idx] * u_control[idx]) + 
                           (2.0 * S_slew_weight[idx] * (u_control[idx] - u_prev[idx]));
    END_FOR;

    rNormDiff := 0.0;
    FOR idx := 1 TO 4 DO
        tempDelta := u_control[idx] - (rStepSizeAlpha * gradient_J[idx]);

        IF (tempDelta - u_prev[idx]) > 1.2 THEN
            tempDelta := u_prev[idx] + 1.2;
        ELSIF (tempDelta - u_prev[idx]) < -1.2 THEN
            tempDelta := u_prev[idx] - 1.2;
        END_IF;

        IF tempDelta > 250.0 THEN
            tempDelta := 250.0;
        ELSIF tempDelta < -250.0 THEN
            tempDelta := -250.0;
        END_IF;

        rNormDiff := rNormDiff + ABS(tempDelta - u_control[idx]);
        u_control[idx] := tempDelta;
    END_FOR;

    IF rNormDiff < rMpcConvergenceTol THEN
        EXIT;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 6: PASSIVE INDUCTRACK II ELECTRODYNAMIC LIFT & DRAG SYNTHESIS
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rPodVelocity_ms > 1.5 THEN
    tempDelta := (rTrackLitzLoopResistance_Ohm / (rWavenumber_k * rPodVelocity_ms * rTrackLitzLoopInductance_H));
    rPassiveLiftForceTotal_N     := 240000.0 / (1.0 + (tempDelta * tempDelta));
    rPassiveDragForceTotal_N     := rPassiveLiftForceTotal_N * tempDelta;
    bPassiveInductrackSufficient := (rPodVelocity_ms >= 45.0);
ELSE
    rPassiveLiftForceTotal_N     := 0.0;
    rPassiveDragForceTotal_N     := 0.0;
    bPassiveInductrackSufficient := FALSE;
END_IF;

rEstimatedNormalForce_kN := (rPassiveLiftForceTotal_N + 
                            ((u_control[1] + u_control[2] + u_control[3] + u_control[4]) * rForceToCurrentCoeff_NA)) * 0.001;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 7: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION & MULTI-QUADRANT RECONFIGURATION LOGIC
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bQuad1_ActiveHealthy := (rCryogenicTemp_FL_K < 5.8) AND (NOT wFaultWord2.8);
bQuad2_ActiveHealthy := (rCryogenicTemp_FR_K < 5.8) AND (NOT wFaultWord2.9);
bQuad3_ActiveHealthy := (rCryogenicTemp_RL_K < 5.8) AND (NOT wFaultWord2.10);
bQuad4_ActiveHealthy := (rCryogenicTemp_RR_K < 5.8) AND (NOT wFaultWord2.11);

tCryoQuenchTimer_FL(IN := (rCryogenicTemp_FL_K >= 5.8), PT := T#50MS);
IF tCryoQuenchTimer_FL.Q THEN wFaultWord2.12 := TRUE; END_IF;

tCryoQuenchTimer_FR(IN := (rCryogenicTemp_FR_K >= 5.8), PT := T#50MS);
IF tCryoQuenchTimer_FR.Q THEN wFaultWord2.13 := TRUE; END_IF;

tCryoQuenchTimer_RL(IN := (rCryogenicTemp_RL_K >= 5.8), PT := T#50MS);
IF tCryoQuenchTimer_RL.Q THEN wFaultWord2.14 := TRUE; END_IF;

tCryoQuenchTimer_RR(IN := (rCryogenicTemp_RR_K >= 5.8), PT := T#50MS);
IF tCryoQuenchTimer_RR.Q THEN wFaultWord2.15 := TRUE; END_IF;

IF bQuad1_ActiveHealthy AND bQuad2_ActiveHealthy AND bQuad3_ActiveHealthy AND bQuad4_ActiveHealthy THEN
    rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[1];
    rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[2];
    rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[3];
    rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[4];
    bDegradedLevitationActive      := FALSE;
ELSE
    bDegradedLevitationActive := TRUE;
    wSystemStatusWord.12      := TRUE;

    IF NOT bQuad1_ActiveHealthy THEN
        rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[2] * 1.35;
        rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[3] * 1.35;
        rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[4] * 0.70;
    ELSIF NOT bQuad2_ActiveHealthy THEN
        rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[1] * 1.35;
        rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[3] * 0.70;
        rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[4] * 1.35;
    ELSIF NOT bQuad3_ActiveHealthy THEN
        rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[1] * 1.35;
        rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[2] * 0.70;
        rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[4] * 1.35;
    ELSIF NOT bQuad4_ActiveHealthy THEN
        rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[1] * 0.70;
        rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[2] * 1.35;
        rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A := u_control[3] * 1.35;
        rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A := 0.0;
    ELSE
        rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A := 0.0;
        iOperationalState              := 80;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 8: MULTI-STAGE HIERARCHICAL OPERATIONAL STATE MACHINE
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tStateTimer(IN := NOT bStateFirstScan, PT := T#24H);

CASE iOperationalState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: SYSTEM COLD BOOT & SENSOR CALIBRATION INTEGRITY CHECK *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0001;
        bSystemReady      := FALSE;

        rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 100.0;
        rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := 0.0;
        rCompressorGuideVaneAngle_deg    := 0.0;
        rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm  := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;

        IF bSystemEnable AND (iTubePressure_HealthyChannels >= 2) AND
           (iGap_FL_HealthyChannels >= 2) AND (iGap_FR_HealthyChannels >= 2) AND
           (iGap_RL_HealthyChannels >= 2) AND (iGap_RR_HealthyChannels >= 2) AND
           (rDCBusVoltage_V >= 780.0) THEN
            iOperationalState := 10;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: TUBE SUB-ATMOSPHERIC PUMPDOWN & INTERLOCK VERIFICATION *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0002;

        IF rVotedTubePressure_mbar <= 2.50 THEN
            iOperationalState := 20;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        ELSIF rVotedTubePressure_mbar > 8.00 THEN
            wFaultWord1.6     := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bSystemEnable THEN
            iOperationalState := 0;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: CRYOGENIC SUPERCONDUCTING PRECHARGE & BEARING LEVITATION *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0004;

        IF (rCryogenicTemp_FL_K < 5.0) AND (rCryogenicTemp_FR_K < 5.0) AND
           (rCryogenicTemp_RL_K < 5.0) AND (rCryogenicTemp_RR_K < 5.0) THEN
            rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 25.0;
            rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm  := 15.0;

            IF rCompressorShaftSpeed_rpm >= 8000.0 THEN
                iOperationalState := 30;
                bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: LOW-SPEED ROLLOUT & INDUCTRACK LIFTOFF TRANSITION *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0008;

        rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm := 65.0;

        IF rPodVelocity_ms >= 45.0 THEN
            iOperationalState := 40;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: FULL TRANSONIC CRUISE - ACTIVE MPC & SURGE MITIGATION *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0010;
        bSystemReady      := TRUE;

        rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm := 120.0 * (1.0 - (rCompressorShaftSpeed_rpm / rSupervisoryCompressorSpeedSetpoint_rpm));
        IF rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm < 0.0 THEN
            rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm := 0.0;
        ELSIF rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm > 185.0 THEN
            rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm := 185.0;
        END_IF;

        IF (rKantrowitzChokeRatio > 0.92) OR (rTotalPressureRatio_Pi > 6.8) THEN
            iOperationalState := 50;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        tSurgePersistTimer(IN := (rSurgeMargin_pct < 6.0), PT := T#40MS);
        IF tSurgePersistTimer.Q THEN
            wFaultWord1.9     := TRUE;
            iOperationalState := 90;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF rPodVelocity_ms < 38.0 THEN
            iOperationalState := 60;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: TRANSIENT SHOCKWAVE MITIGATION & AEROTHERMAL CHOKING BYPASS *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0020;

        rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := 60.0;
        rCompressorGuideVaneAngle_deg    := 35.0;

        IF (rKantrowitzChokeRatio <= 0.82) AND (rTotalPressureRatio_Pi <= 5.5) THEN
            rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := 0.0;
            iOperationalState                := 40;
            bStateFirstScan                  := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: HIGH-DECELERATION REGENERATIVE DESCENT & TOUCHDOWN PREPARATION *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0040;

        rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm  := 0.0;
        rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 40.0;

        IF rPodVelocity_ms < 5.0 THEN
            iOperationalState := 70;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: STATION APPROACH & MECHANICAL DOCKING ALIGNMENT *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0080;

        rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 100.0;
        rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := 0.0;
        rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm  := 0.0;

        IF NOT bSystemEnable THEN
            iOperationalState := 0;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: DEGRADED FAILSAFE PASSIVE HALBACH DAMPING *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0100;

        rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 80.0;

        IF (rPodVelocity_ms < 35.0) AND (rActiveLevitationHeight_mm < 9.0) THEN
            wSystemStatusWord.14 := TRUE;
            iOperationalState    := 99;
            bStateFirstScan      := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: EMERGENCY SURGE DUMP & AERODYNAMIC BRAKING *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0200;

        rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 100.0;
        rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := 100.0;
        rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm  := 0.0;
        bEmergencyVentTriggered          := TRUE;

        IF rPodVelocity_ms < 1.0 THEN
            iOperationalState := 99;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE 99: HARD FAULT TOUCHDOWN LOCKOUT *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#8000;
        bSystemReady      := FALSE;

        rAntiSurgeBypassValveCommand_pct := 100.0;
        rSecondaryBypassValveCommand_pct := 100.0;
        rCompressorInverterTorqueCmd_Nm  := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad1_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad2_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad3_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;
        rHalbachQuad4_CurrentCommand_A   := 0.0;

        IF bResetFaults AND bEmergencyStop THEN
            wFaultWord1       := 16#0000;
            wFaultWord2       := 16#0000;
            iOperationalState := 0;
            bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iOperationalState := 99;
        bStateFirstScan   := TRUE;

END_CASE;

bStateFirstScan := FALSE;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
